description:
Audit conducted 2026-05-10: ~30 sites in source/docs/comments and 2 beads (JMAP-06zp formal defer_until + JMAP-r3pg.14 'deferring to 0.2.0' in notes) contain deferral language that hides real work from the bd ready frontier.

This epic reclassifies all of them as active open beads so the work is visible. No deferred-status hiding, no '0.2.0 window' framing, no untracked-in-source 'deferred to a future version' boilerplate.

## Scope

1. Bead admin (mechanical):
   - Clear defer_until on bd:JMAP-06zp (metadata extension epic)
   - Rewrite bd:JMAP-r3pg.14 notes to drop 'deferring until 0.2.0' framing

2. File new beads for ~20 source/doc deferrals that have no bead ID:
   - Server CallerCtx forwarding API (4 server crates)
   - Chat extension method completeness (Space/set sub-ops, PushSubscription/update+destroy, Quota/changes, role/member/channel mutations)
   - mail-client typed wrappers for Email/import + Email/parse
   - mail-server header forms (As* variants)
   - mail-server: push filter/sort into backend
   - chat-client: drop duplicated auth/blob/client/error/sse/ws modules (now that base-client lands)
   - tasks-types: typed JSCalendar sub-types
   - Workspace-wide UTCDate newtype migration
   - *-server helpers.rs builder-struct refactor (7 sites)

3. Edit source/docs to drop 'deferred to a future version' / 'future iteration' framing and replace with active bead references.

4. Fix stale doc: jmap-calendars-types/PLAN.md:358 still says 'future jmap-sharing-types crate' when the crate already exists.

## Acceptance

- grep -rn 'deferred to a future' across workspace → 0 hits
- grep -rn 'future iteration' / 'future window' / '0.2.0 window' → 0 hits in active-work contexts
- All open beads have defer_until = NULL
- No bead notes contain 'deferring until' active-work language
title: EPIC: undefer all workspace deferrals — reclassify as active open work
